newsitem.title: USA: Wilmar rating changed on price - analyst.
newsitem.headline: Wilmar rating changed on price - analyst.

text.p: -- PaineWebber analyst Todd Berko said he upgraded the rating of Wilmar Industries Inc to buy from attractive on Thursday based on price.
-- "The price has come way down but the fundamentals remain intact," he said. "The stock has languished. I feel it is underfollowed and overlooked."
-- Most recent high was 28-3/4 on January 1; the stock has steadily fallen since.
-- Shares were flat at 17 in early trading.
